label: Michael Della Rocca, PSR Pp.1-10: Acceptance of a particular EXPLICABILITY_ARGUMENT_4 does not by…
locator: pp.1-10: pp.2–5, definition and repeated local-scope qualifications; pp.5–6, modality and existence transition
interpretation: Della Rocca defines an explicability argument by rejection of a state because its obtaining would be inexplicable, and repeatedly distinguishes local uses from general PSR commitment. This reading does not deny his subsequent case for extending the demand; it preserves the local-to-global step that argument must address.
